name: Upsampling Artifact Detection
description: Detects artifacts from upsampling operations used in GAN generators. These artifacts create periodic patterns in the frequency domain.
mechanism: Analyzes frequency domain for periodic patterns caused by transposed convolution or upsampling layers in generative models.
parameters: Search: frequency domain peaks, Pattern: periodic artifacts
source: Chandrasegaran et al. (2021), GAN Upsampling Artifacts
useCase: Detecting GAN upsampling artifacts in generated images

references.title: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005). Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Traces of Resampling. IEEE TSP.
Kirchner, M. & Böhme, R. (2008). Hiding Traces of Resampling in Digital Images. IEEE TIFS.
Gallagher, A.C. (2005). Detection of Linear and Cubic Interpolation in JPEG Compressed Images. CCECE.

strengths:
• Detects interpolation patterns from upscaling operations
• Effective for both traditional and neural upsampling
• Frequency analysis reveals periodic interpolation artifacts
• Can identify specific upsampling algorithms
• Works on any image format
limitations:
• High-quality AI upscalers minimize detectable artifacts
• Anti-aliasing can mask interpolation patterns
• Original native-resolution images show no artifacts
• JPEG compression adds confounding frequency components
• Requires sufficient image size for analysis
